name: bitvavo-mcp
description: Bitvavo (trading): list_markets, get_ticker, get_candles. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: GET /v2/markets returns every market (BTC-EUR, ETH-USDC, ...) in one answer: the server filters by `query` (substring of the market, base or quote, case-insensitive), sorts by symbol and pages locally; the list is fetched once per minute at most. raw has status (trading, halted, auction, ...), order limits, tickSize and orderTypes.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: symbol is a market from list_markets, e.g. BTC-EUR. 24-hour ticker: last trade price, best bid/ask and the base-currency volume of the last 24 hours; raw has open/high/low, bidSize/askSize and volumeQuote.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: interval is one of 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 8h, 12h, 1d, 1W, 1M (the documented values); returns the latest `limit` candles, newest first, as documented. time is the candle start in UTC.
